summary: This clinical trial studies the impact of taking daily multivitamins on vitamin and mineral levels in adults using certain weight loss medications called GLP-1 receptor agonists. Erasmus Medical Center is sponsoring this study, which has a status of Enrolling by invitation and aims to include 246 participants. Half of the participants will receive a multivitamin supplement, while the other half will receive an inactive substance called a placebo. The trial has a phase of No phase.
